data.description:
## Context / Problem
61 `rebar.__all__` functions (`src/rebar/_lib_{reads,writes,mutations,gates,ops,identity}.py`) leave 84 parameters unannotated: 61 `repo_root=None` and 23 others. The MCP-derivation story in this epic derives tool input schemas from these signatures, and FastMCP maps an unannotated parameter to `{"type":"string"}` (`func_metadata`, `WithJsonSchema` fallback), so unannotated params would produce wrong tool schemas. Annotation is additive: no signature order, default, or behaviour changes. Cites are on origin/main 083620b0.

## Approach
Apply exactly this annotation table (census: `_lib_reads` 15 fns, `_lib_gates` 11, `_lib_mutations` 11, `_lib_ops` 10, `_lib_identity` 8, `_lib_writes` 6):
- `repo_root` (61 functions): `repo_root: str | os.PathLike[str] | None = None` everywhere (add `import os` where missing). This matches the sinks `config.tracker_dir` (`config.py:166`) and `_reads._tracker` (`_reads.py:30`); 886 test call sites pass `Path`. Widen the two typed sinks `_lib_warn.py:44` and `_commands/cross_session.py:33` (both `str | None` today) to the same union.
- `str` (7): `add_identity_key.identity_id/public_key`, `revoke_identity_key.identity_id/public_key` (`_lib_identity.py:105,127`), `bridge_projects_set.key`, `bridge_projects_remove.key` (`_lib_ops.py:113,136`).
- `str | None = None` (7): `append_session_log.summary/relates_to/discovered_from`, `start_session_log.summary/relates_to/discovered_from` (`_lib_mutations.py:84,121`), `claim.assignee` (`_lib_writes.py:390`).
- lists (4): `bridge_projects_set.repos: list[str]`; `attach_commits.commits: list[str | dict[str, Any]]` (`_lib_mutations.py:302` accepts SHA strings or `{sha,…}` dicts); `set_file_impact.impact: list[FileImpactEntry] | str` (`_lib_gates.py:136`; JSON string accepted at `:140`); `set_verify_commands.commands: list[VerifyCommandEntry] | str` (`:182`). `FileImpactEntry`/`VerifyCommandEntry` come from `rebar.types:122,129`, already imported under `TYPE_CHECKING` at `_lib_gates.py:21`.
- `sign_manifest.manifest: list[str] | str` (`_lib_identity.py:166`; a JSON-array string is accepted).
- DSSE (2): `add_identity_key.signature: dsse.Envelope | None = None`, `revoke_identity_key.signature: dsse.Envelope` (`_commands/identity.py:437` requires `dsse.Envelope`); add `from rebar.attest import dsse` under the existing `TYPE_CHECKING` block at `_lib_identity.py:25`.
- I/O (2): `export_tickets.out: TextIO | str | os.PathLike[str] | None = None` (`_lib_reads.py:57`); `import_tickets.source: str | os.PathLike[str] | TextIO | Iterable[str | dict[str, Any]]` (`:95`).
- `edit_ticket(**fields: Any)` (`_lib_mutations.py:149`).
Nothing regenerates: `scripts/gen_api_surface.py:93-108` records only `[name, kind, default]` plus the return annotation, so `tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json` is unchanged. Update the 22 `repo_root=None` spellings in `docs/reuse-surface.md` prose (not test-pinned). All 61 functions already carry return annotations, so `make typecheck` is the oracle for the bodies.

## Scope
`src/rebar/_lib_reads.py`, `src/rebar/_lib_writes.py`, `src/rebar/_lib_mutations.py`, `src/rebar/_lib_gates.py`, `src/rebar/_lib_ops.py`, `src/rebar/_lib_identity.py`, `src/rebar/_lib_warn.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/cross_session.py`, `docs/reuse-surface.md`, new `tests/unit/test_library_facade_annotations.py`. Out of scope: any signature reorder, default change, or MCP file.

## Testing
`tests/unit/test_library_facade_annotations.py::test_every_public_callable_parameter_is_annotated`: iterate `rebar.__all__`, assert no parameter has `inspect.Parameter.empty` as its annotation. `::test_repo_root_annotation_is_uniform`: every `repo_root` annotation resolves (via `typing.get_type_hints(fn, localns=vars(rebar.types))`) to `str | os.PathLike[str] | None`. `make typecheck` green. `python scripts/gen_api_surface.py --check` unchanged. `python scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py` stays green (it compares names only; the derivation story deletes it). `make verify`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The census test reports 0 unannotated parameters across `rebar.__all__` (new unit test).
- [ ] `python scripts/gen_api_surface.py --check` passes with no baseline change (CI `make test`).
- [ ] `make typecheck` and `make verify` exit 0 (run locally before push).
- [ ] `git diff --stat` touches only the Scope files (review).
data.title: Annotate the 84 unannotated parameters on the public library facade
